statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has documented bradycardia and symptomatic pauses
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The service is to capture real-time rhythm data during daily activities
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I49.5, and R55
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial is because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
